title: An ANYREF parameter receives a column reference that the body can use as a column
query: DEFINE FUNCTION CountDistinct = ( c : ANYREF ) => COUNTROWS ( DISTINCT ( c ) )

source.quote: The expression types ( AnyRef , ColumnRef , etc) type must be expr as its references (columns, tables, measures, etc.) need to be evaluated in the function's context.
source.supports: the reference is used in the body as the column

derivation: c stands for Product[Color] in the body: DISTINCT ( Product[Color] ) is Red, Blue, Green, 3 rows.
alternative: The page has no example of a column reference passed on to DISTINCT (its MODEX example passes a reference to TABLEOF and ADDCOLUMNS). If a reference parameter cannot be used where a column name is required, the query fails with an error.
